messages:
Jordan - CSM: Hey all — ThermoGrid popped up on my watchlist, we have a ~58% drop in token volume week-over-week. Notable: active routes went from 12 -> 3.
Eli - AM: Wow, thanks for flagging. Renewal window in ~40 days per Renewal-bot. cc @Jordan — who is the current champion?
Jordan - CSM: Leah (Head of ML) is on parental leave. Procurement/Platform now led by Rajesh Singh (Director of Platform). They're running a competitive bake-off (NimbusAI + CloudPrompt).
Priya - Solutions: Do we know specific friction points driving the drop?
Jordan - CSM: Two things surfaced: 1) They disabled auto-batching last month citing "unexpected latency spikes", 2) embedding relevance complaints (mismatch on vector search recall). Also KV cache hit rate collapsed.
Maya - Onboarding: They never finished the custom prompt templates from PoC, ticket #3421 is blocked by their infra firewall rule.
Jordan - CSM: Pulled quick usage query to verify:
```sql
SELECT date, SUM(tokens) AS tokens
FROM api_events
WHERE customer_id = 'thermogrid' AND date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 60 DAY)
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date;
```
Jordan - CSM: Quick facts: 1) 58% token drop last 7d vs prev 7d; 2) KV cache hit went 68% -> 5%; 3) error spike (timeouts/429) around 2026-02-28.
Eli - AM: That error spike + firewall change lines up. Any traces from runtime? @eng-runtime can you weigh in?
ops-bot: Incident-Alert: Dedicated endpoint d-thermo-1 reported 3 failures between 2026-02-28T18:14:03Z and 2026-02-28T18:16:21Z.
eng-runtime: Looking at traces now, seeing several long tail RPCs to KV store and increased connection resets from their IP range. Likely network filtering + retries causing request collapse.
Priya - Solutions: Immediate pragmatic play: offer to run a perf migration test with batching+quantized model variant, show head-to-head latency/cost. Also provide embedding tuning doc for recall improvements.
Maya - Onboarding: Lift firewall rules temporarily (staging) or provide allowlist IPs — I'll coordinate with their infra lead. Ticket #3421 updated.
Jordan - CSM: Proposed outreach plan: 1) 30m with Rajesh + Leah backup (TPM) to demo perf delta; 2) offer 3 months migration credit + a short SLO during window; 3) deliver a one-pager comparing our runtime vs NimbusAI using their corpus.
Eli - AM: I'll draft the outreach email and request exec sync. Target: within 10 days. If usage doesn't recover, mark renewal as high-risk.
Priya - Solutions: I'll prepare the benchmark harness and example scripts. Also example curl + python snippets for enabling continuous batching and embedding tuning.
Jordan - CSM: Cache & batching guidance to include in outreach:
```yaml
batching:
  enabled: true
  max_batch_tokens: 2048
  max_batch_size: 64
kv_cache:
  enabled: true
  ttl_days: 7
```
Jordan - CSM: Suggested commercial levers: short-term credits, a migration SLO, and a small price concession if they commit to Dedicated capacity.
Eli - AM: Agreed. I'll also request the competitive evaluation materials from Rajesh (scoring criteria, dataset).
Maya - Onboarding: I'll attach their blocked logs and ping their infra lead for the allowlist.
Jordan - CSM: Assigning actions: Eli (outreach + exec invite), Priya (benchmarks + artifacts), Maya (firewall/allowlist), Jordan (customer notes & logs).
Eli - AM: ack. :thumbsup: 
Priya - Solutions: I'll have a draft benchmark report by EOD Friday.
Jordan - CSM: Thanks — let's try to get the exec sync scheduled before the end of week 2 next month. If any blocker, call it out in this thread so we can escalate. :raised_hands:
